title: Window functions
summary: Use windows when you need group-aware calculations while retaining row-level detail.

blocks.text: Use windows when you need group-aware calculations while retaining row-level detail.

items: PARTITION BY defines the independent groups.
ORDER BY defines sequence for ranking, running totals and lag/lead.
ROW_NUMBER is deterministic only when the ordering is deterministic.
Window functions run after WHERE/GROUP BY in logical query processing.

blocks.title: Example

blocks.text: A window keeps the input grain: every input row stays in the output. GROUP BY collapses rows to the grouping grain. Filtering on a ranking result (for example rn = 1) is how you change the grain deliberately, and it needs an outer query or QUALIFY because WHERE is evaluated before window functions.

blocks.title: Latest event per customer (new grain: one row per customer)
blocks.code:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT e.*,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY e.customer_id
           ORDER BY e.event_ts DESC, e.event_id DESC  -- tie-breaker makes it deterministic
         ) AS rn
  FROM events e
)
SELECT *
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;
